name: Bournemouth Airport

runway.quote: The Airport's runway is 2,271 metres in length.

hours.quote: The normal operating hours of the Airport are 06:30 - 21:30.

curfew.v: Outside 06:30–21:30 local, movements only with prior permission; out-of-hours charge 21:30–06:15; requests for 01:00–06:15 must be in before 21:30 and are not guaranteed
curfew.quote: Outside of the notified operating hours, prior permission is required for all operations.

ppr.quote: All aircraft movements at Bournemouth Airport are subject to Prior Permission Required (PPR).

handling.v: All GA aircraft must use an airport-approved handling agent, booked before arrival
handling.quote: All GA aircraft are required to be handled by a Handling Agent approved by the Airport Company

noise.v: QC8 and QC16 aircraft banned at night; night quota budget 23:30–06:00 (3,100 points a year)
noise.quote: Those aircraft that have a quota count of 8 or 16 are not permitted to operate at night.
